changes_made.explanation: This paper focuses on natural language UNDERSTANDING tasks (sentiment analysis, linguistic acceptability, similarity, paraphrase, NLI), not natural language GENERATION. The extracted NLG tasks were only mentioned as background examples, not as tasks actually studied/evaluated in this paper.

The paper does not evaluate NLG outputs. F1 and AUC are classification metrics used for NLU tasks (sentiment classification, etc.), not NLG evaluation metrics. No generation metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, etc. are used.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators of generated outputs. BERT is used as part of the model architecture, not as an evaluator.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations of generated outputs. All evaluations use automated classification metrics on standard benchmarks.

overall_notes: This paper is about NLU (Natural Language Understanding), not NLG (Natural Language Generation). It focuses on using synthetic gaze data to enhance language understanding models for classification tasks. The original extraction incorrectly categorized it as an NLG evaluation paper.
